levels.name: Street and platform level
levels.note: One side platform: all trains use track 1, beside the station building on Ratakatu. No signposted level names; no lift is needed between building and platform (none in OSM, none named by VR).

answers.question: Which platforms have stairs/lifts?
answers.answer: There is one platform (track 1) at street level beside the station building; no lifts are recorded by VR or OSM. OSM has footbridges with stairs at the bus-station end and an underpass at the west end, unconfirmed by any owner source.
answers._source: Wikipedia 'Vaasa railway station', https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vaasa_railway_station, read 2026-10-30; VR 'Vaasa' station page, https://www.vr.fi/rautatieasemat-ja-reitit/vaasa, read 2026-10-30; OpenStreetMap (osmfacts extract /home/claude/osmfacts_fi/FI-VS.json), read 2026-10-30
